remarks: Immaculate & spacious in-house apartment has separate back entry and is totally private.  Features include sunny new flooring, large living/dining area with sliders to patio, sleeping alcove, full custom walk-in closet, cute kitchenette and beautiful newer marble bath, all presented in impeccable condition. Rent includes all utilities except internet and 1-off street parking space. Enjoy life in the popular neighborhood of Springdale, walking distance to popular restaurants, bars and Metro north train station and also convenient to all Stamford has to offer. Due to the nature of this property, owner does reserve the right to meet & approve prospective tenant. Owner looking for 1-person occupancy only. GOOD CREDENTIALS AND CREDIT ARE A MUST. Washer & dryer in kitchen area is shared w/landlord only.
